svg.title: Laria shard layout
svg.desc: Eight shard files, one per storage node; each file holds the same shard position from every stripe and is protected by a SHA-256 checksum recorded in metadata.json.
svg.text: Each shard file is one column: shard i of every stripe, in order. Each storage node keeps one file.
Returned by encodeFile() — keep it with the caller.
Not in metadata: shards alone are unreadable.
(plus zero padding of the last stripe)
